references.text: The camp at Shiloh is mentioned as the place where the Israelites gathered, the same place to which the men returned with a description of the land.
Joshua gave an assignment to three men from each tribe to go through the land and write down a description of it, which is carried out in verse 9.
Joshua instructed the men to divide the land into seven parts, and in verse 9 they completed this task by writing down the division.
Moses recorded the stages of the Israelites' journey, a similar documentation of important geographical information as in Joshua 18:9.
Moses gave the command to distribute the land by casting lots among the nine and a half tribes, which is the background for the land distribution in Joshua.
Describes the method of distributing the land by casting lots, the same principle used after the men had mapped out the land.
Nehemiah mentions that he inspected the walls of Jerusalem, a similar systematic inspection and documentation of an area.
